from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from math import asin, sqrt

def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(2)
    # |q1 q0> = 1/sqrt3 (|00> + |01> + |10>)
    # p(q1=1)=1/3
    theta = 2 * asin(sqrt(1 / 3))
    qc.ry(theta, 1)          # prepare q1
    qc.x(1)                  # flip control to get control=0
    qc.ch(1, 0)              # H on q0 iff q1==0
    qc.x(1)                  # unflip
    return qc

from math import asin, sqrt, pi

def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(2)

    # marginal of qubit 0 : p0 = |00|^2+|10|^2 = 2/3
    theta = 2 * asin(sqrt(1 / 3))          # cos(theta/2)=sqrt(2/3), sin(theta/2)=sqrt(1/3)
    qc.ry(theta, 0)

    # for q0 = 0 we need (|0>+|1>)/sqrt2 on qubit 1, for q0 = 1 we need |0>
    # a negative control is realised with X - CRY - X
    qc.x(0)
    qc.cry(pi / 2, 0, 1)   # Ry(pi/2) on qubit 1 iff q0 == 1
    qc.x(0)

    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from math import asin, sqrt, pi

def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(2)

    # Ry(a) on q0, Ry(b) on q1, CX 0->1, Ry(c) on q1
    # with sin(a/2)=1/sqrt3 , b - c = pi , sin b = -cos b
    a = 2 * asin(sqrt(1 / 3))          # sin(a/2)=1/√3 , cos(a/2)=√(2/3)
    b = 3 * pi / 4                     # sin b = -cos b = √2/2
    c = -pi / 4                        # c = b - pi

    qc.ry(a, 0)
    qc.ry(b, 1)
    qc.cx(0, 1)
    qc.ry(c, 1)

    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
import math

def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(2)
    amp = 1 / math.sqrt(3)
    # Qiskit little-endian ordering: |q1 q0> -> index = q1*2 + q0
    # |00> = 0, |01> = 1, |10> = 2, |11> = 3
    qc.initialize([amp, amp, amp, 0.0], [0, 1])
    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
import math

def solve() -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(2)

    # Ry(a) on q1, Ry(b) on q0, CX 1->0, Ry(c) on q0
    # sin(a/2)=1/sqrt3 , b-c = pi/2 , b+c = pi/4
    a = 2 * math.asin(1 / math.sqrt(3))
    b = 3 * math.pi / 8
    c = -math.pi / 8

    qc.ry(a, 1)
    qc.ry(b, 0)
    qc.cx(1, 0)
    qc.ry(c, 0)

    return qc
